{{Top|leg}}
A '''nano-jump''' was a spaceflight involving the insertion of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and traversing a distance which was measured in [[Nanosecond/Legends|nanoseconds]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Nano-jump'' when first mentioned in Han Solo at Stars' End was spelled ''nanno-jump''.<ref name="Solo" />
